method.sourceReview: Individual complete publisher video, full2fps sequence plus all169 stroke completion samples at10fps; ambiguous intervals enlarged and replayed.
method.completionMeaning: strokeEndsSeconds are inspected nominal sample bounds by which the painted stroke is complete, not exact pen-lift timestamps. ffmpeg fps resampling can select a nearby original frame. Original tentative samples and corrected additional samples are preserved.
method.geometryReview: Final paths rendered at actual width5 with round caps/joins and compared against source painted geometry;231 explicit source-based contact/gap relations.
method.lineage: sourceStrokeIndices preserve generator primary mapping. strokeLineage preserves every original stroke used in split/merged outputs. Source-authored 著 dot has no upstream index.
method.mediaHandling: All original videos and corpus processed in memory; source bytes/SHA pinned; no video/frame files persisted.
